sonnet.problem: The question re-asks a fact the earlier cards already settled. Card 3 says the LORD rejected Eliab, card 6 shows Abinadab was not chosen, and card 7 says Samuel told Jesse the LORD hadn't chosen Shammah either. Asking how many of the seven the LORD has chosen is the same fact again, and a baker can answer it from those cards without learning anything new.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
